component.name: Asura
component.summary: Inspect the traffic of Wine and Proton applications

description.p: Asura captures the HTTP and HTTPS traffic of selected programs without a system proxy. It is built for Windows applications and games running under Wine and Proton, and works with native Linux programs too.

ul.li: Capture a launched program, a running process or a Steam game with asura-run %command%
Decrypt HTTPS with a local certificate authority installed into Wine prefixes
Inspect HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2 and WebSocket traffic with headers, bodies and timing
Filter requests with a query language and export them as HAR
